踏入洞口，骤然坠入无边幽暗。

洞内空气潮湿阴冷，混杂着地底淤泥的腥气、陈年蛊虫的残味、古老咒术沉淀的阴煞气息，沉闷压抑，吸入肺腑都隐隐透着一丝侵体寒意。通道蜿蜒向下倾斜，由人工开凿与天然溶洞拼接而成，岩壁湿漉漉凝着水珠，滴答声响在寂静洞内格外清晰，更添幽深诡异。

众人踏入洞内之后，李安琪抬手引动灵气，在队伍周身凝成一圈淡白色石质灵光罩，微光萦绕，既照亮前路数丈范围，又能隔绝地底阴冷煞气、抵御暗处突发偷袭。

柔和灵光映照岩壁，能清晰看到两侧石壁刻满隐晦的东瀛古文咒纹，纹路陈旧斑驳，布满青苔水渍，显然已经存在数十年之久。部分咒纹隐隐还有微弱气息流转，是常年自行吸纳地底阴气维系，不曾彻底消散。

“洞内通道错综复杂，分叉极多。”胡九郎缓步前行，天眼透视幽暗，清晰看清前方地底脉络、通道分叉、岩壁中空夹层，“是精心设计的迷宫迷局，以天然溶洞为骨架，人工开凿分支岔路，布设多重幻阵、迷魂阵，误入岔路便会陷入循环死路，被困地底，活活耗死。”

钱丹袖中白蛊成群，在前方低空盘旋飞舞，莹白微光点点，辨识周遭蛊气、毒气、阵纹气息：“左右几条岔路都布有蛊瘴迷阵，地底暗藏毒蛊巢穴，一旦误入，会被蛊潮围困，而且阵纹会扰乱心神，让人分不清虚实，在迷宫里不断打转。”

范梦雪雷光萦绕指尖，细碎银芒照亮前路，雷气扫过周遭暗处：“还有残留的低级式神虚影藏在岩壁夹层、幽暗角落，靠着洞内阴气苟存，虽战力不强，却擅长蛊惑幻音、扰乱阵型，偷袭心神破绽。”

“不乱走岔路，跟着地气主脉走。”胡九郎沉声吩咐，“迷宫迷局再复杂，主脉地气不会作假，顺着灵气最厚重、地势最平缓的主通道前行，避开所有旁支岔路，不被幻境、幻音迷惑。”

众人凝神颔首，目不斜视，紧跟主路稳步前行，绝不随意张望两侧幽暗岔口。

洞内幽深寂静，只有脚步轻踏地面的声响、岩壁水珠滴答声，偶尔从幽暗深处飘来若有若无的低吟幻音，似人似鬼，蛊惑心神，试图牵引众人偏离主路，误入迷阵死路。

好在人人贴身佩戴纯阳玉牌、护身符箓，再加钱丹白蛊净化、胡九郎道韵镇心，幻音刚入耳便被强行抚平，根本扰乱不了众人道心神智。

前行约莫半柱香时间，通道豁然开阔，进入一处巨大的天然溶洞大厅。

溶洞穹顶高耸看不见顶，周遭岔路纵横交错，密密麻麻通往不同地底区域，如同蛛网密布。大厅地面平整，铺着陈旧破碎的青石地砖，中央立着一座残破的石制祭台，样式简约古朴，不同于山巅祭坛的繁复邪异，更偏向隐秘祭魂、研习咒术所用。

大厅四周岩壁下，散落着大量腐朽的草席、破损木案、锈蚀法器残骸、破碎蛊囊碎片，处处都能看出曾经有人长期在此修行、打坐、驯养蛊虫、研习咒术的痕迹。

Chapter 99: The mystery of the cave and the remains of the classics - "The 749th Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

Stepping into the cave entrance, you suddenly fell into boundless darkness.

The air in the cave is damp and cold, mixed with the fishy smell of underground mud, the residual smell of old poisonous insects, and the sinister aura of ancient spells. It is dull and depressing, and there is a faint chill that invades the lungs when you inhale it.The passage is winding and sloping downward, and is made up of artificial excavations and natural caves. The rock walls are wet with water droplets, and the ticking sound is particularly clear in the silent cave, making it even more mysterious and eerie.

After everyone stepped into the cave, Li Anqi raised his hand to activate the spiritual energy, which condensed into a circle of pale white stone spiritual light around the team. The faint light lingered, not only illuminating a few feet of the road ahead, but also isolating the cold evil energy underground and resisting sudden sneak attacks in the dark.

The soft spiritual light shines on the rock wall, and you can clearly see that the stone walls on both sides are carved with obscure ancient Japanese curse patterns. The patterns are old and mottled, covered with moss and water stains, and they have obviously been there for decades.Some of the curse patterns still have a faint aura circulating, which is maintained by absorbing the Yin Qi from the ground all year round and has never completely dissipated.

"The passages in the cave are complicated and have many forks." Hu Jiulang walked forward slowly, his eyes piercing through the darkness, and he could clearly see the underground veins, bifurcated passages, and hollow interlayers in the rock wall ahead. "It is a carefully designed maze puzzle, using the natural cave as the skeleton, artificially digging branch roads, and laying out multiple illusion and ecstasy arrays. If you stray into the fork, you will fall into a dead cycle, be trapped underground, and die alive."

There are swarms of white poisonous poisonous insects in Qian Dan's sleeves, circling and flying at low altitude in front of him. The glistening white light is dotted, and he can identify the poisonous poisonous gas, and the atmosphere of the formations around him: "The forked roads on the left and right are covered with poisonous poisonous poisonous formations. There are hidden poisonous poisonous poisonous nests underground. Once you enter by mistake, you will be surrounded by the tide of poisonous poisonous insects. Moreover, the formations will disturb the mind, making people unable to distinguish between reality and reality, and they will keep spinning in the maze."

Fan Mengxue's thunder light lingered on her fingertips, and the fine silver light illuminated the way forward. The thunder energy swept through the darkness around her: "There are still low-level shikigami phantoms hidden in the interlayer of the rock wall and in dark corners, relying on the Yin Qi in the cave to survive. Although they are not strong in combat, they are good at bewitching phantom sounds, disrupting formations, and sneaking attacks on mental flaws."

"Don't take random deviations, follow the main line of earth energy." Hu Jiulang commanded in a deep voice, "No matter how complicated the maze puzzle is, the main line of earth energy will not cheat. Follow the main channel with the thickest spiritual energy and the gentlest terrain, avoid all side roads, and do not be confused by illusions and phantom sounds."

Everyone nodded attentively and followed the main road steadily without squinting their eyes, never casually looking at the dark forks on both sides.

The cave is deep and silent, with only the sound of footsteps tapping the ground, the dripping of water drops on the rock wall, and occasionally a faint murmur of phantom sounds drifting from the depths of darkness, like a human or a ghost, bewitching the mind, trying to lead everyone away from the main road and into a maze of dead ends.

Fortunately, everyone wore pure Yang jade tablets and amulets close to their bodies, coupled with Qian Dan Bai Gu to purify and Hu Jiulang Dao Yun to calm the mind, the phantom sounds were forcibly smoothed out as soon as they entered the ears, and they could not disturb the minds of everyone at all.

After walking forward for about half a stick of incense, the passage suddenly opened up and entered a huge natural cave hall.

The dome of the cave is so high that no one can see the top, and the surrounding roads are crisscrossed, leading to different underground areas, like a dense spider web.The floor of the hall is flat, paved with old and broken bluestone floor tiles, and a broken stone altar stands in the center. The style is simple and simple. It is different from the complicated and evil altars on the top of the mountain. It is more used for secretly worshiping souls and studying spells.

Under the rock walls around the hall, there are a large number of decayed straw mats, damaged wooden cases, rusted remains of magical instruments, and fragments of broken voodoo sacs. Everywhere you can see the traces of people who have practiced, meditated, tamed voodoos, and studied spells here for a long time.
